links.outcome: Accuracy, safety, and guideline adherence of LLMs on bariatric surgery vignettes
links.effect: GPT-5 accuracy 87.3% vs Gemini 72.4%; guideline adherence 78% vs 46%; unsafe recommendations 2.1% vs 8.4%; unsafe outputs persisted.
links.quote: GPT-5 achieved higher accuracy (87.3% vs. 72.4%), stronger guideline adherence (78% vs. 46%), and fewer unsafe recommendations (2.1% vs. 8.4%).

links.outcome: Head-to-head comparison of two candidate LLMs on the same vignettes
links.effect: GPT-5 outperformed Gemini on composite score (6.92±0.61 vs 5.43±0.88; P<0.001); Gemini 4 times more likely to produce an unsafe action (RR 4.0; 95% CI 2.2-7.3).
links.quote: Gemini was 4 times more likely to produce an unsafe action than GPT-5 (risk ratio, 4.0; 95% CI, 2.2-7.3).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the comparative performance and safety of two LLMs (GPT-5 vs. Gemini) using clinical vignettes scored by surgeons, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
